correctness.rationale: The stated finite Markov process has permanent petal synchronization. Exact first resolution of a mixed leaf petal gives c. Two conditional rate balances give a,b; their harmonic equations have a unique absorbing solution with geometric increment q, proving hub aH and leaf cH. Neutrality is evaluated directly. Fixed-nonneutral asymptotics follow by rational expansion and geometric exponent; the m=2 factorization is a positive-coefficient polynomial identity checked by exact integer convolution. Exact labeled-state absorption chains and rational harmonic cases independently verify finite examples; the infinite claims rely on analysis, not numeric runs.

originality.rationale: The motivating 2023 primary paper treats group overwrite but defines its star by all leaf-pair hyperedges, whereas the present structure has pairwise-disjoint petals; the difference changes transitions and prevents deduction of the new closed-form law. The closest graph paper allows only single-vertex copying. Searches did not expose a dominating all-fitness loose-star formula, but publication priority is provisional.

value.rationale: Hyperedge overlap is a natural biological and social modeling parameter for whole-group copying. The exact all-size sparse-star law gives a rare closed absorption probability and locational asymmetry for three-body evolution, while distinct positive/negative selection asymptotics quantify suppression and its scaling against Moran. The m=2 polynomial comparison is an exact, naturally smallest nontrivial group-structure benchmark, not a narrowly chosen arbitrary parameter sample.
